intro: Saturday brings new robot-learning tools, coding agents in team conversations and a softer Canadian labour market. Coastal storms continue, while Vancouver planning offers intimate concerts, practical AI design and a fresh morning coffee stop.

stories.title: ToyBlocks opens a controlled world for robot learning
stories.summary: Ai2 introduced ToyBlocks, an open simulation framework built around a robot arm and tabletop blocks. Automatically generated demonstrations let researchers vary training tasks, repeat experiments and investigate failures without collecting every example through human teleoperation.

stories.title: Cosmos adds four interactive simulation checkpoints
stories.summary: NVIDIA released four open-weight Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for driving scenes, simulator imagery and robot-action video prediction. Each has 16 billion trainable parameters; downloadable weights and adaptation recipes offer starting points for physical-AI experiments.

stories.title: Copilot review settings become programmable
stories.summary: GitHub added REST and GraphQL management of Copilot code review settings, from enterprise policies to repository preferences. New attribution fields identify AI reviews and comments, while available metadata reports review effort and sources such as instructions and tools.

stories.title: GitHub’s Slack and Teams assistant reaches general availability
stories.summary: GitHub’s chat integration can investigate bugs, create issues, implement changes and open pull requests from Slack or Teams conversations. Teams also gains Canvas for reviewing plans, code changes and previews together; onboarding can identify repositories directly from messages.

stories.title: Zeballos evacuates 22 properties over landslide risks
stories.summary: Zeballos ordered 22 properties evacuated Friday as heavy rain brought flooding, debris and landslide risks to northern Vancouver Island. Emergency operations centres are coordinating the response, with another rain system expected Saturday evening into Sunday.

stories.title: Canada’s unemployment rises as employment stalls
stories.summary: Canada’s unemployment rate increased to 6.7% in October while employment remained essentially unchanged, Statistics Canada reported Friday. Private-sector employment fell by 53,000 as public-sector employment rose by 50,000; the national employment rate declined for a third consecutive month.

events.description: Rogue Folk Club pairs James Keelaghan and Jez Lowe for a Friday evening concert at its Kitsilano hall. Advance admission is $40, compared with $45 at the door; a separate $20 streaming ticket offers an at-home option.

meetups.title: Vancouver AI examines where human judgment belongs
meetups.description: Design strategist Zoë Zaslow presents four practical takeaways, then follows one project’s division of responsibilities between people and machines. Networking begins at six, with the program at seven and questions afterward; registration is open.

dining.date: 2026-11-07 · Creatures Coffee at Strange Fellows Brewing, 1345 Clark Drive, Vancouver
dining.title: Creatures gives Strange Fellows a morning identity
dining.description: The brewery’s new coffee program pairs espresso, contrasting batch brews and loose-leaf tea with ExAnimo pastries. Refillable bean tins offer discounted replenishment, while updated seating makes room for longer visits; weekend coffee hours run from eight until two.
